responsibility: Centralizes borrow-check diagnostic support code and exports, providing `MirBorrowckCtxt` helpers to describe places, find relevant spans, explain closure captures and method uses, and coordinate the specialized diagnostic submodules.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the diagnostics-focused entry point within borrow checking, gathering the helper routines and submodules that turn borrow-check facts into user-facing errors and notes. Unlike the sibling borrow-checker `mod.rs` files, it does not drive analysis or inference itself.
